reason: The mess in my Telegram groups is real, but I've lived with it for years and I only dig in when something smells wrong. I'm not putting an unknown bot into groups full of transfer screenshots, and I'm not building my bookkeeping around a tool from a small team I've never heard of.
objection: Will this still be running in a year? If it shuts down or gets sold, my team's routine breaks and some outsider has had my bank transfer screenshots the whole time.
would_change_my_mind: Another villa operator in Bali I know telling me they've used it for six months or more without problems, plus a clear name and company behind the bot.
